description: List statutory tax-rate slabs by jurisdiction — IN GST (5/12/18/28 + zero + exempt + composition trader/manufacturer/restaurant + compensation cess), UK VAT (20 / 5 / zero / exempt), AU GST (10 / GST-free / input-taxed), US sales-tax (state-administered summary, no federal rate), CA GST 5% + HST 13% ON / 15% Atlantic / 14% NS + provincial PST 7% BC / 6% SK / RST 7% MB + QST 9.975% QC, SG GST 9% (+ superseded 8% / zero / exempt), NZ GST 15% (+ zero / exempt), AE VAT 5% (+ zero / exempt). Filter by `country`, `taxType` (GST/VAT/Sales-Tax/HST/PST/QST/IGST/CGST-SGST/TDS/TCS), or `scheme` (standard / reduced / zero / exempt / input-taxed / composition / cess / state-summary). Every entry carries an effective-from date and an authoritative `source` URL (CBIC, gov.uk, ATO, CRA, IRAS, IRD, FTA, Tax Foundation) — agents should confirm the rate against the source before quoting figures to a user. Use this when a user asks "what is the GST rate on X?", "what VAT band does Y fall into?", or "what are the composition slabs in India?". This is the public statutory reference — for an org-specific tax assignment use the authenticated books_classify_event tool.

country.description: Filter to one jurisdiction. Omit to return every supported country.

scheme.description: Filter by slab category — standard, reduced, zero, exempt, input-taxed, composition, cess.

taxType.description: Filter by statutory tax type (GST, VAT, Sales-Tax, HST, PST, QST, etc.).

name: list_tax_rates
